notes.content:
Hello and happy December!

notes.title: November Update - Jet Packs and Map Update
notes.content:
Hello! There have been many small updates recently and I think it's time for a changelog thing! 

Last week: 

- New [b]Jet Pack[/b] ability added!
- Landings has had some extra "cliff bits" added on the East section and a new spawn point right at the back in the middle. 
- Ravine has been expanded and changed around a little bit.
- The Random Challenge button on the main menu now generates a better random challenge (no more 100 vs 25 matches) 
- Abilities can now be used by clicking the mouse (they still work with the old "e" and "f" buttons if you preferred that) 
- Fixed a bug where you could still capture a base after exploding.

Today:
- Added a back button during the mission briefing which takes you back to the main menu.
- Missions 1 to 5 have no Bomber Eggs so new players can get into it easier.
- Very Low Quality setting added (this has no shadows and lowers a few textures even further)
- Auto-Deploy button added! 
- AI Medics now heal even more often but the effect radius is smaller.

notes.title: Another New Map! More Optimising! Minimaps!
notes.content:
Hello! It has been a while since the last update announcement but there have been loads of updates since! 

I ought to make a list of all the changes because when it comes round to writing the announcement I forget most of it! 

Here we go...

[h1]NEW MAP[/h1]

I'm working on a few historical maps for a new campaign episode. The first map is [b]El Alamein[/b]! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/2a4a590e5b3b930772ec44ccebbf7044924ad081.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/e44cabf1862e74d6babb26dc8b3735e1790d81a3.jpg[/img]

[i]Woah... what's that? A map?[/i]
That's right! It's a minimap! If you get lost or want to check the current state of the battle you can use the brand new minimap! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/61e84e83ea33c3ab2276fda99b95d1562be3a1fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Optimising[/h1]
I've been working and testing a few different things to make the game run smoother, it's currently performing a lot better than it did! Like... a lot better. But there is still a way to go! I must have got a bit carried away putting new features in without thinking how it would affect the performance. We've all learned something this week, right?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/286835931e483575a31f9dfec8ebd1f86c7892b6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other map changes[/h1]

[b]Alps[/b] has had some new things added and old things removed!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/1d053062fb29da7e338b023a421a8f3e918a17dd.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/3c497520c1d2b937d5f82488ca104f1731ec4500.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Map! Optimisation! Things! More things!
notes.content:
Hello! Wow! Yes! 

There's a new map, it has got a castle! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/024a5dce677fff410fbe6b31f67d0d2f5d6d1d8f.png[/img]

Wow!
What else?

We have been working on re-working some things to make the game run much more smoothly. This first update will change a few of the major things that were causing frame drop issues. You SHOULD see a slight improvement with the frame rate. There is still a long way to go but we are working hard on making the game run better!

[h1]Things![/h1]

[b]MAJOR EGG[/b]
- During missions 1 & 2 Major Egg will give hints explaining the basics of Eggs 1942 for new players
- During a Conquest match Major Egg will give you updates on how long is left of the match
- During a King of the Hill match he will tell you if the enemy team has captured the base

[b]ABILITY CHANGES[/b]
- You can now upgrade the shockwave ability power
- Shockwave now makes a little sound
- Bomber Egg explosions are now even larger

[b]AI CHANGES[/b]
- AI Eggs are more likely to go to capture a base instead of towards the nearest enemy egg or player
- The defending team in a Conquest mode will NOT go towards bases to capture them unless there are no attacker eggs nearby
- The attacking team in a Conquest mode will be much more likely to aim for bases instead of eggs or player

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]
- You can now rotate the camera when waiting for respawn with Q & E
- There's a new map image for Château d'oeuf

notes.title: Hats, Map Updates and more!
notes.content:
Hello eggs! I'm back! 

Over the last few days I've uploaded lots of little updates and patches. Now comes the part where I try to remember what I did.

[h1]Hats![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/235f738abf0cf3df0ef4758ca78bb2965d17439a.png[/img]
Yes... you can now unlock hats and put them on your egg! There is already quite a selection and I'm sure there will be many more coming very soon. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/e85eaf08e12f3e390d8074ef851fe1781a14b14a.png[/img]

Hats are unlocked in different ways, some by reaching a certain level, some by completing missions and others by getting Steam achievements. 

[h1]Map Updates[/h1]
Most of the maps have had updates. I didn't make a note of all my changes so here's what I remember:

- [b]Arena[/b] now has moving walls that start at random times.
- [b]Arena[/b]'s blocks have been slightly moved around.
- [b]Arena[/b] now has a few tank traps and barbed wire scattered around.
- [b]Egg Island[/b] has had a few new bases added and some island extensions. 
- [b]Bridges[/b] has also had a few new bases added and some rougher ground in areas. 
- [b]Alps[/b] has had some new mountain top areas added.
- The bridges on [b]Alps[/b] are now slightly wider.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/0a1a945293587a12fdc42767a510bf1c61b3f43c.gif[/img]
- You can now [b]Push[/b] by pressing "F". Pushing will push you forwards slightly. You can use Push to get away from enemies or launch yourself into them.
- There's a "Push" and "Jump" icon in the bottom right of the screen which go brighter when they are ready to be used.
- You can now upgrade "Push" and "Jump" in the Egg Upgrades menu.
- You can now see both team's capture progress when capturing a neutral base with the enemy team. 
- Capturing neutral bases is now much slower.
- AI enemies now wear hats, green kettle helmets for The Royal Egg Force and Stahlhelms for The Bad Eggs. 
- AI enemies now drop their hats when they are cracked.
- Upgrade stats now load when the game loads instead of only when you go to the Egg Upgrade menu.
- Fixed the bug where Bomber Eggs would blast Heavy Eggs through surfaces or into space.

notes.title: Lots of little updates!
notes.content:
Hello Eggs!

This week I will be getting the final things prepared for my wedding which is [b]on Saturday[/b] and then I'll be away for a couple of weeks after that.

I wanted to get a load of things added / fixed before I go away so I've been uploading lots of little updates most days. 

Here's a list of the things that have changed:

[h1]20th July[/h1]

- Capturing / Defending range for the bases has been increased so you can capture from further away.
- Capturing / Defending bases is slightly slower.
- Player gets Cracks for self destructing as a bomber (finally)
- Player gets Cracks for hitting enemies with artillery (way too OP) 

[h1]21st July[/h1]

- Put the option to change class during a match back in (Sorry I took that out, that was silly)
- Artillery Crew class added! (Only these guys can use the turrets because they're a easy way of getting free Cracks)
- Scout has been nerfed slightly
- Heavy cannot be destroyed by Bomber Eggs explosions
- Eggs destroyed by you when you self destruct as Bomber now count towards your Crack total (fixed)

[h1]23rd July[/h1]

- Temple has been updated quite a bit
- New achievement for cracking 1,000 eggs
- Required level for unlocking classes has been increased 
- Radius for capturing / defending bases slightly increased again
- Capturing bases is slightly slower
- Less xp for capturing bases

There's probably a load of other things I've missed, too!

notes.title: Recent updates, additions and fixes
notes.content:
Howdy Eggs! You may or may not have noticed a few new things in Eggs 1942. 

[h1]Levels[/h1]
The biggest recent addition to Eggs 1942 is the introduction to player levels and the XP system. This is still very much in the early stages and will be added to, tweaked and fiddled. 

Most of the Missions and Egg Classes are locked for lower level players.

[h1]How do I get XP?[/h1]
I'm glad you asked! Currently the main source of XP comes from the number of enemy eggs you've cracked. If you win a match then the number of cracked eggs gets doubled and added to your current XP. You also get bonus XP if you're playing a Mission - the harder the mission, the more points you get. 
Oh! Almost forgot. You get XP from capturing and defending spawn bases. 

[h1]New "end of mission" screen![/h1]
When you finish a match there's a new screen which tells you how many eggs you cracked and how much XP you've earned. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32752932/788ec9657f04e4ccfc5a0df5b3c8513bcc672612.png[/img]

[h1]More things![/h1]

- Added "extra damage" and "extra health" as combo perks. These are currently unlocked at x5 and x10 combos. 

- When a base is captured it sends out a little force that pushes all nearby eggs away.

- AI eggs no longer SOMETIMES spawn next to a base, always inside.

- The text that tells you about the game mode has been repositioned to the centre of the screen.

- The flag which indicates you are near a base is now the colour of the team which currently possesses that base.

notes.title: Steam Achievements, Combos and more!
notes.content:
Hello eggs! Just a quick update this time. 

[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]
- Every episode completed from the Missions list will award you an achievement. 
- Getting certain amounts of cracks gives you achievements.
- I'm planning on adding more Steam achievements soon. 

[h1]Combos[/h1]
- Cracking a few Bad Eggs in a short amount of time will give you a combo. 
- [b]In a later update[/b] combos will activate special abilities.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- When you get cracked while capturing an enemy base you no longer carry on to capture it from beyond the eggy grave. 
- There was one music track that YouTube didn't like people using - that's gone now. 
- The final mission for The Battle for Egg Island is now LESS impossible.
- The first mission for Saving Private Egg is now a little bit harder. 
- The second mission for Saving Private Egg is now on the new Trenches map.
- On "Trenches" map there is a new trench linking the two blue starting bases.

notes.title: Capturing Bases and Controller Update
notes.content:
Hello again! 

I've done a quick (but temporary) fix for the capturing bases issue! In this latest update the player will be able to capture neutral (white) bases and turn enemy bases blue. 

This is only temporary because the way bases will be captured and defended is being completely overhauled for a future update. Stay tuned for a much better base capturing experience! 

This update also has a few controller improvements / bug fixes.

- Changing and selecting a different class now works with an Xbox / Windows controller. 
- If the reinforcements are ready then you can respawn instantly by selecting a class from the list. 
- A "deadzone" added to the right stick to stop the automatic spinning that occurred when not touching the stick. 

I'm still working on getting the menus to all work with a controller but this should mean you have a much better combat experience for the time being. 

Enjoy the eggs!

- With Reverse Mode on and Conquest Mode on (Defending) The Bad Eggs will start with all the neutral bases.

notes.title: Partial Controller Support added!
notes.content:
Good morning! 

Today we added partial controller support to Eggs 1942.

We're just testing to see how the game feels using a Windows / Xbox controller. Currently you can only use the controller for combat - menus will still require a mouse and keyboard.

For controller controls see the "How to Play" menu. If you come across any bugs related to the controller input then please let us know!

notes.title: Update! Egg Classes and New Map!
notes.content:
Hello eggs! 

This update contains many things! Mainly Egg Classes and a brand new map.

[h1]What are egg classes?[/h1]

I'm glad you asked! 

Each Class has different skills and abilities. There are currently 3 different Classes in Eggs 1942 - I have plans to add more soon. 

[h1]Scout Egg[/h1]
The scout egg can move fast and jump high. When moving fast you will take no damage!

[h1]Bomber Egg[/h1]
The bomber egg can self destruct causing damage to nearby eggs. Health does not regenerate!

[h1]Heavy Egg[/h1]
The heavy egg cannot sprint or jump very high but is larger and takes less damage from impact!

The AI and player can both spawn as each of these classes. 

[h1]What about this new map?[/h1]

It's called [b]Arena[/b] and is an... arena! It has fire, an egg audience, more fire, quite small, flat, some fire, eggs and fire! 

[h1]Anything else?[/h1]
Yes! Here's a list of some other new things / fixes.
[list]
[*] Getting hit by bombs falling from planes now damages eggs!
[*] Pressing Esc doesn't just instantly quit the battle anymore, it goes to the respawn menu where you can select what class to respawn as. 
[*] Pressing Esc in Spectator Mode now works - no more getting stuck as a Spectator!
[*] Heavy Eggs now look quite rough. 
[*] Bomber Eggs now look quite shiny. 
[*] A settings menu added. 
[*] Some extra reading material in the "How to Play" menu.
[*] "R - Respawn" and "Waiting for reinforcements..." text now outlined so you can actually read it on Alps.
[*] "Max Score" and "Time" text in Custom Battle menu is now yellow. 
[*] Jump cooldown reduced to 3 seconds instead of 4.

I think that's everything!
